About these English warm-ups

English Warm-ups is a free collection of 19 interactive, five-minute games for young English learners at A1–A2 level, created by Ms Ikram Boudaoud (The Fed Up Teacher). Use them at the start of a lesson, in the classroom or online: verb tenses, negative sentences, comparatives and superlatives, irregular verbs, adverbs of frequency, possessive adjectives, auxiliaries and modals, telling the time, weather and clothes, prepositions of place, classroom phrases and Algerian dinars. Open any card, press Start and play. Play, Learn, Repeat!
